author: delegated owner/auditor
purpose: FRESH one-shot R-CAL corpus under AM47 viability-necessity. 12 NEW balanced pairs; each pits a SOUND novel mechanism against a PLAUSIBLE-but-impractical one (real engineering ideas failing a specific feasibility/testability ground, NOT absurd physics). Tests whether the AM47 prompt corrects the R142 systematic novelty-bias. One-shot, burn after.
protocol: AM47 judge prompt (viability-necessity); blind+sha-parity swap; per-judge acc>=0.8 AND answered>=0.9 AND |over_novel-over_cons|<=1; >=3 qualified from >=2 non-agnes families; inter-judge alpha>=0.6.

pairs.problem: SWRO brine discharge raises local salinity harming benthic life.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Multi-port diffuser array sized by a near-field plume model to hit a target boundary dilution.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Deep disposal-well injection with a diamond-drilled completion.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is sound+novel; baseline is plausible-but-impractical. Deep-well disposal is site-geology-risky and untestable at this coastal plant; diffuser is feasible+testable on salinity transects.

pairs.problem: Continuous steel caster breakouts when the shell thins at mold exit.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Self-healing ceramic mold liner that flows into cracks at temperature.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Breakout prediction from mold thermocouple-array thermal signatures with auto casting-speed trim.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is plausible-but-impractical; baseline is sound+novel. Self-healing liner is plausible but unvalidated at caster thermal cycling (testability low); thermocouple prediction is feasible+testable.

pairs.problem: Tablet blend content uniformity drifts during hopper discharge.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Feedback hopper vibration/fill control from inline NIR blend spectra.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Quantum-dot tracer tagged to each API particle for real-time tracking.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is sound+novel; baseline is plausible-but-impractical. Quantum-dot tracer is regulatory-infeasible (toxicity) in GMP; NIR feedback feasible+testable.

pairs.problem: Laser powder-bed fusion parts show lack-of-fusion porosity.
pairs.a1_mechanism: In-situ ultrafast-laser shock peening to close internal voids layer-by-layer.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Closed-loop laser power from coaxial melt-pool pyrometry keyed to a thermal model.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is plausible-but-impractical; baseline is sound+novel. Shock-peening closes surface not internal lack-of-fusion voids; mechanism unvalidated for internal defects (testability low); melt-pool feedback feasible+testable on CT.

pairs.problem: Industrial robot joint backlash degrades path accuracy.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Dual-encoder full-closed-loop control with a learned backlash compensation map.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Magnetorheological-fluid locking layer in the harmonic drive to null backlash.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is sound+novel; baseline is plausible-but-impractical. MR-fluid locking at joint speeds is untestable/unvalidated (response time); dual-encoder control feasible+testable.

pairs.problem: Li-ion pack thermal runaway propagates cell-to-cell.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Phase-change-material inter-cell layer absorbing runaway heat.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Inter-cell aerogel barriers + vent-gas-sensor-triggered directed cooling manifold.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is plausible-but-impractical; baseline is sound+novel. PCM capacity is insufficient for full runaway heat (testable failure); aerogel+vent-gas cooling feasible+testable.

pairs.problem: Underground mine roof falls from undetected bed separation.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Distributed fiber-optic strain sensing along roof bolts with a convergence alert model.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Shape-memory-alloy roof bolts that self-tension on heating.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is sound+novel; baseline is plausible-but-impractical. SMA actuation force/temperature is impractical for roof loads (feasibility low); fiber-optic sensing feasible+testable.

pairs.problem: Retort sterilization over-cooks the surface to reach cold-spot F0.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Handheld gamma-ray wand passed over each package for surface sterilization.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Model-predictive retort trajectory from a validated cold-spot model + wireless core probe.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is plausible-but-impractical; baseline is sound+novel. Gamma wand dose-uniformity/shielding/regulatory infeasible; MPC trajectory feasible+testable on F0.

pairs.problem: Ship hull biofouling raises fuel consumption.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Ultrasonic anti-fouling transducers driven by a fouling-growth model keyed to route temperature.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Engineered living biofilm coating that consumes settling organisms.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is sound+novel; baseline is plausible-but-impractical. Engineered living biofilm is ecological/regulatory infeasible; model-driven ultrasonics feasible+testable.

pairs.problem: Plasma etch rate is non-uniform across a 300mm wafer.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Atomic-layer-selective etch via a self-assembled-monolayer resist.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Zone-controlled ESC temperature + edge-ring tuning from a wafer-scale etch model with inline metrology.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is plausible-but-impractical; baseline is sound+novel. SAM-resist selectivity/uniformity untestable at 300mm scale; zone ESC+edge-ring feasible+testable.

pairs.problem: Wind gearbox bearing microcracks grow to spalling.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Oil-debris + vibration-envelope trending with a remaining-useful-life model triggering inspection.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: In-situ induction re-melting of the bearing race to heal microcracks.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is sound+novel; baseline is plausible-but-impractical. Re-melting destroys the race heat treatment (testable failure); RUL trending feasible+testable.

pairs.problem: Grid transformer winding hotspot accelerates insulation aging.
pairs.a1_mechanism: Magnetocaloric gadolinium-regenerator cooling at the winding.
pairs.baseline_mechanism: Fiber-optic winding hotspot sensing + dynamic loading limit from a thermal-hydraulic model.
pairs.label_rationale: VIABILITY-NECESSITY: a1 is plausible-but-impractical; baseline is sound+novel. Magnetocaloric capacity/field impractical at transformer scale (feasibility low); fiber-optic hotspot + dynamic loading feasible+testable.

digest_canonicalization: sha256 over json.dumps(corpus_without_selection_sha256_field, indent=1, sort_keys=True); recompute by removing selection_sha256 then hashing
